objective: Prospectively falsify whether non-token coarse-to-fine causal-feature composition improves unfamiliar held-out action-effect inference and safe confidence over WSP142 while retaining old knowledge and disclosing all symbolic and conventional controls.

lineage.frozen_predecessor: WSP142 DEVELOPMENT_NEW_CAUSAL_COMPOSITION_NO_GO, odd three-way four ANF terms cannot fit three-term capacity; five-way false confidence; no WSP142 seed reuse
lineage.reference: Kumbong et al Next-Concept Modeling arXiv 2610.14162 October 2026, coarse-to-fine inspiration only, NOT architecture transfer, tokens, transformer or paper speed claims.

hypothesis: From public action consequences, a bounded coarse-to-fine latent concept lattice (raw bits then pair conjunctions then recursively refined 3-,4-,5-way conjunctions) with 4-term capacity and ambiguity-aware inference will outperform original <=3-term weight learner on newly composed causal rules without increasing confident error, but may tie a fully informed same-prior exact symbolic solver.

source.input: six binary state dimensions; 64 public typed x inputs with opaque IDs, identities public before actions
source.schedule: EXACT source-independent WSP135 N.schedule() fixed 32 distinct interventions/world; no active selection; source custodian query once per x, never replay; responses shared to all arms

families.known: private random permutation p: b[p0]&b[p1] XOR b[p2] XOR (seed&1), 2/3 terms
families.three: private p: p0&p1&p2 XOR p2&p3 XOR p4 XOR (seed&1), 3/4 terms
families.five: private p: p0&p1&p2&p3&p4 XOR p1&p4 XOR p5 XOR (seed&1), 3/4 terms and rare activations
families.cross: private p: p0&p1&p2 XOR p3&p4&p5 XOR p0&p5 XOR (seed&1), 3/4 terms; two separate higher-order interactions
families.off: independent private seeded Bernoulli1/2 outputs per each of 64 states, unrelated to small sparse laws

learner.mode: NCM-inspired NONTRANSFORMER TOKENLESS coarse-to-fine causal concept construction
learner.level0: Construct source-blind constant, primitive raw bit concepts, then pair conjunctions, fit sparse GF2/XOR weight combinations of <=4 active terms on public observed effects only.
learner.level1: Only when no consistent <=4 term explanation exists at degree <=2, expand concepts by conjunction of existing factors with an unused primitive raw bit, to degree3; evaluate all exact <=4-term combinations.
learner.level2: If still insufficient, expand to degree4 and then degree5 and repeat exact fit. The graph is a bounded generated AND-lattice, not a prelisted set of completed laws. Rank by minimum depth needed for consistency, minimum number of nonzero terms, then minimum total monomial degree. Preserve ALL tied optimal programs, no arbitrary topK truncation; if >10000 solutions at best rank conservatively abstain rather than sample a subset.
learner.inference: For previously unseen x emit y only if every tied best-ranked program predicts identical binary outcome and the program family passes safety ambiguity. Abstain otherwise; count all confident false predictions.
learner.budget: Max four distinct conjunction terms and max degree five, no source-family seed, full truth, source graph or held outcome in learner. No gradient/transformer/tokens.
learner.memory: Restore saved source-blind paid rows, level, retained tied programs or abstention state; verify equal all64 before/after restore, prior known worlds unchanged after later training, zero-call relabel views exactly original responses.

controls.original: exact unchanged WSP142 direct_weights.fit <=3 on identical paid rows
controls.flat_symbolic: independently implemented exact <=4-term flat full-conjunction basis with identical minimum depth, terms, degree tie-breaking and all tied programs; must produce identical 64 outputs to hierarchical model, if tie cannot claim unique NCM/numeric intelligence
controls.cart: unchanged independently FULLY FITTED WSP135 CART per world
controls.wsp135: unchanged WSP135 17640 latent learner, same paid source events
controls.ablation: coarse-only degree<=2 with 4 term cap using same hierarchy fitter, evaluate separately

frozen_decision.stop_criteria: No retries or revisions on exposed seed results, no posthoc threshold changes. On computation explosion >10000 best-rank models abstain; keep counter and reason; source limit 56*32. GitHub workflow bounded 90min but no original-source dispatch.
